feedback: No earlier race exists, so nothing here is measured for this geometry. Integration choices made: the five sensors are weighted in proportion to their x position (-2 to +2), so the signal is a clean, linear reading of line offset, and the 0.06 m forward offset is handled with modest kd. Depending on the next race: if line_loss_events is above zero on the slalom or the s-bend, the five-sensor sum is probably dropping below 0.05 at the tape edge, so widen the array (for example, x out to ±0.06 with the same count) or raise sensor_size to 0.016. If steering_oscillation is high while rms_error stays low, the forward offset is adding signal lag, so move the sensors back (y toward 0.03) and check again. If completion_time is above 3 s with no line losses, the wheel track or mass is limiting turn response; reduce mass or increase wheel_radius to raise speed authority.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events > 0 on slalom or s-bend: widen sensor x span to about ±0.06 m (keep 5 sensors, spacing 0.03 m) or set sensor_size to 0.016, to keep the summed reading above 0.05 at the tape edge.
If steering_oscillation is high while rms_error is low: move sensor y from 0.06 toward 0.03 m to reduce the lag introduced by the forward offset.
If completion_time exceeds 3 s with no line losses: reduce mass toward 0.5 kg or raise wheel_radius toward 0.035 m to increase speed authority; keep wheel_track at 0.12 m.
